criteria.name: defect_catch_rate
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share of their defects that a challenge of the review catches: by naming the defective finding of an examination, or by citing the file and line the prose of a draft names, within 2 lines, with a challenge at least as serious as the defect.

criteria.name: false_challenge_rate
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 when the review of an output without defects raises any challenge, otherwise 0.

criteria.name: critical_calibration
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 when the review's verdict is the one the case's defects call for (block for a critical defect, challenge for any other, pass for none), otherwise 0.

criteria.name: evidence_verified
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share of the examination's critical and high findings whose file the reviewer opened with read_file.
